result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and written certification of deletion thereafter. It preserves the existing termination and payment terms. However, it goes beyond the required Customer Data scope by covering all Company Confidential Information, some of which may not be suitable for machine-readable return. It also measures deadlines from the “Termination Date” even upon expiration, although that term is defined only by reference to a termination notice. These are limited scope and drafting issues rather than failures to achieve the playbook position.
